name: The Arsonist
source:
Set in the modern day, you are kidnapped by a domestic terrorist who is only known as "The Arsonist." Throughout your captivity, you will be forced to choose between what's right and what's necessary to survive. But even if you live, can you still be free at the end of it?

[From [url=https://ataraxicgames.itch.io/the-arsonist-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
